content_sections.heading: NHB Agribusiness Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.national_horticulture_board_nhb_gurugram: NHB Headquarters, Gurugram, Official visits to CDP cluster locations and other places in India as directed by NHB

Master's Degree in Agribusiness Management, Agricultural Marketing, Horticulture, Post Harvest Management, Food Process Engineering and Management, Food Agri-Business Management or Food Supply Chain Management, or a two-year PG Diploma in Agri Business Management; minimum 2 years of post-qualification relevant experience; basic computer knowledge mandatory

content_sections.heading: NHB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NHB/Pers./Engagement of Consultants/CDP/2026/3363 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NHB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Agribusiness Management or Agricultural Marketing, or Horticulture or Post Harvest Management or Food Process Engineering and Management or Food Agri-Business Management or Food Supply Chain Management or a two-year Post Graduate Diploma in Agri Business Management, from a recognised University/Institution. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification relevant experience. Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification relevant experience Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on closing date) Other conditions: Basic knowledge of computers is mandatory Desirable: Experience in coordination, implementation and monitoring of agriculture/horticulture/agribusiness or infrastructure projects Monitoring physical and financial progress; coordination with Government Departments, State agencies, IAs, FPOs/FPCs and financial institutions Monitoring project execution, identifying implementation bottlenecks, examining DPRs and project reports Monitoring fund utilisation and scheme compliance; organising review meetings and field visits Knowledge of horticulture value chains, post-harvest management, cold-chain infrastructure, marketing, export promotion and market linkages

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual, initially for one (01) year from the date of joining May be extended on yearly basis subject to satisfactory performance, continued requirement of NHB and approval of competent authority; extension not automatic No right or claim for regular appointment, absorption, continuation or extension in NHB NHB may terminate the engagement at any time without assigning reason or prior notice Consolidated remuneration inclusive of all components; no other allowance, perquisite or service benefit except approved official tour expenses

rows.event: Last date for email applications (5:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will NHB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications with reference to eligibility, qualifications and experience Interview/interaction of shortlisted candidates Applications scrutinised with reference to eligibility criteria, qualifications and experience Only shortlisted candidates called for interview/interaction; details communicated through email Interview for shortlisted candidates on 27.11.2026 from 11.00 am onwards; exact slot communicated by email NHB reserves the right to adopt an appropriate selection process and not to fill any or all positions

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, duly completed and signed Self-attested copies of degree certificates and mark sheets Self-attested experience certificates indicating period and nature of experience Self-attested copy of PAN Card Recent passport-size colour photograph and any other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHB Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format (application form attached to the notice), complete and sign it. Attach self-attested copies of the listed documents. Email the application to [email protected] and [email protected] on or before 5:00 PM on 25.11.2026. Applications are accepted through email only; a physical copy is not required.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the prescribed date and time, or found incomplete, may not be considered Mere fulfilment of eligibility conditions does not confer any right to be called for interview or selected Place of posting/headquarters is NHB Headquarters, Gurugram
